title: Characters / Fantasy NPC references
summary: The company’s coworkers and future enemies are represented here by provisional Doom-style 2D sprites. Use them as species references for art direction and pictograms. The current Unreal assets are under `/Game/Programming/Enemies/FlipBooks`. The editable owner sources are under `D:/GameJam/Total (in)Sanitation/Characters`. [NPC source and package index](NPC_REFERENCE.md).

items.title: Elves
items.alt: Two native front-walk sprite frames labeled Elf and ElfM
items.body: Current Unreal folders are `Elf` and `ElfM`. The art sources are `Characters/Elf/Female` and `Characters/Elf/Male`. The paired native frame previews show current species cues.

items.title: Fairy
items.alt: Native Fairy front-walk frame on the Unreal texture checkerboard
items.body: Current Unreal folder is `Fairy`. The art source is `Characters/Fairy/Female`. The native front-walk frame is an example of the current sprite representation.

items.title: Goblins
items.alt: Two native front-walk sprite frames labeled Goblin and GoblinF
items.body: Current Unreal folders are `Goblin` and `GoblinF`. The art sources are `Characters/Goblin/Female` and `Characters/Goblin/Male`. The owner’s warning experiment uses a pointed-ear goblin skull as a danger pictogram. The approved Toxic Vapors sign shows how it was carried into the sign family. [Toxic Vapors SVG](sources/signage-stage5-svg/08-toxic-vapors-goblin.svg).

items.title: Orcs
items.alt: Three native front-walk sprite frames labeled FemOrc, Orc, and OrcF
items.body: Current Unreal folders are `FemOrc`, `Orc` and `OrcF`. The art sources are `Characters/Orc/Female`, `Characters/Orc/Femboy` and `Characters/Orc/Male`. Source and runtime folder names are kept as filed.

items.title: Demon / Source reference
items.body: The owner source includes `Characters/Demon/Female/Blender/Female_Demon.blend` and the corresponding FBX. The current FlipBooks inventory covers four other species. Refer to the source branch for the Demon design.

items.title: Engine template references
items.body: Manny and Quinn remain engine proportion and animation templates. The earlier [mesh reference index](REFERENCE_INDEX.json) contains their native preview records. New project character art has a confirmed future destination at `/Game/Art/Characters`.
